summary: Tool data shows all 9 corners passed with TNS 0.0 and no DRV violators. Worst setup slack 5.6705 ns (max_ss_100C_1v60); worst hold slack 0.1082 ns (min_ff_n40C_1v95), positive but thin.
assumptions: All items are assigned to Orion as in the tool output; no item was assigned to Grid.
All numbers are quoted from reports/sta_tool.json; no tool was run in this task.
DFM-005 to DFM-007 have no hotspot locations in the input, so they are ranked from layer statistics only.
IR limit is 0.09 V, i.e. 5% of 1.8 V (A.13 Phase 0 default), as stated in the tool data.
Power corners are tt_025C_1v80, ss_100C_1v60 and ff_n40C_1v95 as given in power_tool.json; all numbers are quoted from that file.
Ranking by real yield impact is my judgement: failure mechanism first (line end open/bridge, CMP density), then absolute exposure for the low items.
Severities are taken unchanged from reports/dfm_tool.json.
Switching activity is the default input activity 0.2 (20%); no simulation activity was supplied.
The 6.000 ns input and output delays and 0.25 ns uncertainty are DEFAULT values from the SDC, not from the spec.
The open flow does not analyze electromigration (EM) or transient/dynamic IR drop, so those are not covered.
The tool's passed flag and empty drv_violators lists are taken as the DRV result; limits used (max fanout 10 from the SDC) are those the tool applied.
Voltage-source locations, IR corner and PDN model are not stated in the input; they are not assumed here.
li 100% near-min-width is treated as expected for minimum-width li landing stubs under mcon; this is an inference from shape geometry, not tool-confirmed.
open_issues: EM is not checked by the open flow.
Hold margin at fast corners is only 0.1082 to 0.1130 ns; a human should judge whether it is sufficient for signoff.
IR analysis conditions (corner, voltage source locations, current model) are not documented in the input; a human should confirm them.
No simulation-based activity is available; power at the default 0.2 activity may not represent real UART traffic.
OpenLane power total (0.0008120654383674264 W) differs from the tt STA total (0.0007882774 W); the cause is not given in the input data.
The SDC leaves clock propagation to the flow; the tool data does not say whether the clock was ideal or propagated for this run, which affects hold confidence.
The tool data gives no cell-level path detail and no hold path endpoints, so dominant cells are not named.
The tool does not report single-cut connections as DFM items because no redundant via fits; a human may want to confirm that the via-fit check is not too strict, given thousands of single-cut vias.
li density windows at 0.5999 vs 0.6 max are effectively at the limit; a human should confirm whether this limit applies as a hard rule for li in this flow.
rx is constrained with a 6 ns input delay rather than a false path (per SDC note); treatment of this asynchronous input needs a human decision.
